orgs.name: Allen Institute for AI
orgs.note: Ai2 (the Allen Institute for AI) describes itself as a non-profit AI research institute founded in 2014 by Paul G. Allen; source URL verified 2026-08-14

blurb: Frontier and industrial research labs, with parent organisation, leadership, funding model, and published work.

reading.body:
The dataset for this category currently contains one entry: Allen Institute for AI, a non-profit research institute founded in 2014.

A single organization cannot support claims about the research-lab landscape as a whole. What the record does establish is that Ai2 operates outside the for-profit funding model that ties most frontier compute expenditure to investor returns, which is a meaningful structural difference when assessing who builds large-scale training infrastructure and why.

The data does not cover funding levels, compute resources, published benchmarks, or any other institutes that belong in this category. Conclusions about non-profit research labs, their role in AI development, or their relationship to power and infrastructure would require a much larger dataset than is available here.
